# Chewy NLP & SEO — Turning customer reviews into product and search intelligence

Generated July 26, 2026 — Sales Brief

Chewy — A Blend360 Case Study

## Executive Summary

Blend360 built NLP models and a human review workflow that transformed customer reviews into product pros, cons, and ranking criteria for Chewy's product experiences. The program connected review intelligence to SEO and site improvements that generated measurable traffic, customer, order, and revenue outcomes. ([chewy case study.pptx], slides 3–7)

## The Challenge

Chewy wanted to identify the product features customers liked and disliked in online reviews, convert those signals into ranking criteria, and tailor landing-page and product-detail-page content. ([chewy case study.pptx], slide 3)

## Our Solution

Blend360 combined topic modeling, attribute extraction, embedding-based clustering, and sentiment analysis with a review application where Chewy employees could validate or override generated recommendations. Validated feedback returned to the NLP models for automated retraining. ([chewy case study.pptx], slides 4 and 6)

## Key Features

- **Review intelligence** — Summarized reviews and clustered related topics. ([chewy case study.pptx], slide 4)
- **Attribute extraction** — Used parts-of-speech tagging and n-gram summaries to identify product attributes. ([chewy case study.pptx], slide 4)
- **Pros and cons analysis** — Aggregated sentiment into product-specific benefits and drawbacks. ([chewy case study.pptx], slides 4–5)
- **Human validation loop** — Let employees review, revise, and approve model outputs before production use. ([chewy case study.pptx], slide 6)
- **Automated retraining** — Fed validated judgments back into the NLP models. ([chewy case study.pptx], slide 4)

## Quantified Outcomes

- **$8.3MM revenue** — Gained from SEO improvements. ([chewy case study.pptx], slide 7)
- **+2.2MM sessions** — Added through higher-value traffic to the site. ([chewy case study.pptx], slide 7)
- **81k new customers** — Attributed in the reported outcome summary. ([chewy case study.pptx], slide 7)
- **588k more orders** — Reported increase in orders. ([chewy case study.pptx], slide 7)

## Business Value

**Inference:** This case demonstrates a reusable closed-loop operating model for converting unstructured feedback into governed content decisions: machine-generated insights, business-user validation, production activation, and retraining. ([chewy case study.pptx], slides 4, 6, and 7)
